notes.title: Exciting Update Alert
notes.notes:
Dear Last Bloody Snack Community,

We are thrilled to announce the upcoming release of our latest version packed with exciting enhancements! Here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*] Bug Fixes: We've been hard at work identifying and squashing those pesky bugs to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.
[*] 
[*] New Languages: We're expanding our linguistic horizons by introducing support for additional languages, making the game more accessible to players worldwide.
[*] 
[*] Controller Support: Enhance your gaming experience with the option to use your favorite controllers. Whether you prefer a gamepad or joystick, we've got you covered.
[*] 
[*] Sound Effects: Prepare to be immersed in the world of Last Bloody Snack with the addition of captivating sound effects that will elevate your gameplay.
[/list]

But that's not all! We want to hear from you. Your feedback is invaluable in making Last Bloody Snack even better. If you have any suggestions or improvements in mind, please share them with us in the community. Together, we can continue to elevate the gaming experience.

We appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm. Thank you for being part of the Last Bloody Snack journey. Stay tuned for the release, and let's make this update a success together!

Best regards,
Small Throne Team...
